notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
New Random Event Added: Guidance on upgrading the Adventurer Store and Specialties Store.
(*Adventurer Store and Specialties Store are further expanded when your reputation reaches 30 or higher.)

Additional Information in Pilot Journal:
Details added for missing descriptions.
(Information about purchasing Dragon Rose, Luminous Primrose, and Mermaid Pearl from the Cool Beak Club (in Theropolis) Store has been added.)

*Luminous Primrose is used in main quests

notes.title: Cloud Heart Officially Released
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I am thrilled to announce that Cloud Heart has officially transitioned out of Early Access and is now fully released!
Starting today, you can freely soar through this steampunk world and enjoy your adventures to the fullest.

Thank you so much for your patience and support!

notes.title: Official release date (December 8, 2024)
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

On [b]Sunday, December 8[/b], Cloud Heart will transition from Early Access to its full official release.

(Please note that there are no differences between the full version and the update released on November 29.)

While everything worked as expected during the test, there is a small chance that if you clear all content in the Early Access version and then update to the full release, the game might not progress correctly. If this happens, I sincerely apologize and kindly ask that you start a new game and progress from the beginning.

(This is because a significant number of internal variables were modified during the transition from Early Access to the full release, which could lead to compatibility issues with previously saved data. 😔

During my tests, the Early Access save data transferred without any issues. However, I wanted to let you know just in case…)

notes.title: Full version updated
notes.content: The full version has been released. You can now play through the ending.

notes.title: 크라우드펀딩이 종료되었습니다/crowdfunding has ended.
notes.content:
hello.

Cloud Heart's crowdfunding has ended.

Even though it didn't reach the goal amount, I was really happy that many more people showed interest than I expected.

I will pay for the English translation of the full version myself.

It will take time, but I will do my best.

thank you!

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
몇몇 몬스터의 체력과 스킬을 조정했습니다. 
"기본 권총" 무기의 업그레이드 조건이 변경되었습니다. (강인함 필요->아무 능력치)
프롤로그 스킵이 추가되었습니다.
사소한 버그들이 수정되었습니다.

HP and skills of some monsters have been adjusted.
The stat required to upgrade “Default Pistol” has changed. (Strength required->Any stat)
Prologue skip added.
Minor bugs fixed.
